 "study": "Saslow 2023",
 "design": "2x2 factorial",
 "country": "USA",
 "duration": "4 months",
 "n_randomized_total": "83",
 "experimental_arm": {
  "label": "VLC diet",
  "intervention_description": "Very low-carbohydrate (VLC) diet, decreasing carbohydrate intake to 20 to 35 nonfiber g of carbohydrates a day, with the goal of achieving nutritional ketosis",
  "n_randomized": "23",
  "n_analyzed": "23",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.32",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.07",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SE",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.09",
  "hba1c_baseline_sd": "0.45",
  "hba1c_final_mean": "5.74",
  "hba1c_final_sd": "0.42"
 },
 "control_arm": {
  "label": "DASH diet",
  "intervention_description": "DASH diet, limiting sodium to <2,300 mg daily and fat intake to 20% to 30% of calories per day, with a variety of fruits, vegetables, lean meats, whole grains, and low-fat dairy",
  "n_randomized": "23",
  "n_analyzed": "23",
  "hba1c_change_mean": "-0.14",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion": "0.07",
  "hba1c_change_dispersion_type": "SE",
  "hba1c_baseline_mean": "6.10",

 }
